title: Rabbi Yitzchak Kaskasa’ah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Berakhot 51a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.51a.1) he explains it before Rabbi Yose bar Avin in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. In [Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 6, halakhah 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.6.1.15), with the additional historical folio locator 40b, he is called Rabbi Yitzchak bar Mari. Hyman reports that Seder HaDorot divides him into two people.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Heilprin places the passages under separate headwords, [Yitzchak Kaskasa’ah](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2169&lang=en) and [Yitzchak bar Mari](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2175&lang=en). Both entries report a teaching in Rabbi Yochanan’s name.
The Bavli calls the speaker Rav Yitzchak Kaskasa’ah. The Yerushalmi calls him Rabbi Yitzchak bar Mari and has Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Avun as his audience. Hyman gives the historical folio 40b.
